title: pilosella brachiata subsp. pieniakensis
intro: Pilosella brachiata subsp. pieniakensis, commonly known as a member of the dandelion family and specifically a subspecies of Pilosella brachiata, is a flowering plant known for its medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to support digestive health and alleviate symptoms of certain conditions. The therapeutic actions attributed to Pilosella brachiata subsp. pieniakensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which are thought to contribute to its potential benefits for wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents responsible for the therapeutic effects of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified through various studies and analyses.
